pages.title: Phase 0-1
pages.text: $(italic)Phase timing varies by preset; use this as an escalation guide, not a day counter.$()$(br2)$(bold)Phase 0: Normal$()$(br)Opening stretch of a fresh world. No effects. Use this time to prepare.$(br2)$(bold)Phase 1: Twilight$()$(br)Early decline. Sun visibly shrinks. Rain becomes frequent. Slight temperature drop. Last chance to see the sun clearly.

pages.title: Phase 2-3
pages.text: $(bold)Phase 2: Cooling$()$(br)The cold becomes real. Temp: -10°C. Permanent rain/snow. Water freezes. Vegetation dies.$(br2)$(bold)Phase 3: The Long Night$()$(br)The first true survival wall. Temp: -25°C. Permanent storms. Lava begins to cool. Fog rolls in. Surface becomes dangerous.

pages.title: Phase 4-5
pages.text: $(bold)Phase 4: Deep Freeze$()$(br)Surface survival becomes lethal. Temp: -45°C. Obsidian freezes. Coal ore crystallizes. Dense fog, near darkness.$(br2)$(bold)Phase 5: Eternal Winter$()$(br)Endgame cold. Temp: -70°C to -120°C. Permanent midnight. Blizzard whiteout. Only deep underground is survivable.

pages.title: Phase 6
pages.text: $(bold)Phase 6: Atmospheric Collapse$()$(br)Final stage. Temp: -120°C to -273°C$(br2)$(italic)Early:$() Extreme blizzard.$(br)$(italic)Mid:$() Atmosphere thins, wind dies, fog lifts.$(br)$(italic)Late:$() Vacuum. Stars visible. No sound on surface. Ice sublimates. Breathing fails outside sealed rooms or habitable oxygen zones.
